overview: The Medford License Commission met to consider a one-day liquor license, a hotel license transfer and entertainment permit, a change of closing hours request, annual 2026 license renewals, and the city's annual population estimation form.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission postponed approval of the November meeting minutes until January.

items.title: One-Day License: Event Them
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for Event Them for a January 17, 2026 gallery opening, conditional upon submission of a certificate of liability insurance.

items.title: License Transfer and Entertainment License: Medford Hyatt Place
items.summary: Approved the transfer of an in-holder all-alcohol license at 116 Riverside Avenue to Coleman Management Inc. doing business as Medford Hyatt Place, subject to a minor address correction. The commission also conditionally approved a new entertainment license pending final sign-offs from city department heads.

items.title: Change of Hours: Razzo's Room
items.summary: Approved a change of closing hours to 1:00 AM for KLME Inc., doing business as Razzo's Grill.

items.title: 2026 Liquor License Renewals
items.summary: Approved the 2026 annual renewals for all alcohol, club, farmer brewery pouring, package store, and wine and malt licenses.

items.title: Renewal Certification and Population Estimation Form
items.summary: Accepted the non-renewal certification for Blue Fuji and approved the estimated 2026 resident population count of 59,898.
